newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Work on Brazil Acre airport to accelerate-Infraero.
newsitem.headline: Work on Brazil Acre airport to accelerate-Infraero.

text.p: Construction work on a new airport in Rio Branco in Brazil's northwestern state of Acre will speed up and conclude in 1997, Brazilian airport administrator Infraero said.

Infraero President Adyr Silva said the airport would serve as a gateway to the member states of the Mercosur customs union, the nations of the Andean Pact trade group, the west coast of the United States and the Pacific.
Rio Branco airport, located near Brazil's border with Bolivia and Peru, is being built to serve large aircraft, especially intercontinental cargo airplanes.
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
